title: Consciousness gives greater flexibility, sensitivity and creativity

statements.text: Consciousness organizes relations between an organism, its environment and its own states, and one of its evolutionary advantages is the greater flexibility, sensitivity and creativity that being conscious gives.

sources.locator: p. 203, quoting The Rediscovery of the Mind, p. 109
sources.quote: one of the evolutionary advantages conferred on us by consciousness is the much greater flexibility, sensitivity, and creativity
